items.title: TikTok updates its AI video ad tools | Social Media Today
items.summary:
TikTok said advertisers will now be able to upload up to 50 multimodal references (images, videos, and audio), up from 9 previously, while the updated Seedance models will now be able to generate up to 30 seconds of video for each prompt, up from a previous 15-second maximum.

TikTok said the latest Dreamina Seedance model is also able to generate sharper, more realistic imagery and offer better lighting and character consistency across video frames. [...] The company also expanded access to its BytePlus tokens, which will enable more use of its Symphony tools for visual generation.

“Starting November 9, advertisers outside North America can purchase BytePlus tokens to access Dreamina Seedance AI models through Symphony, enabling faster video generation, higher-quality output, and more formats,” TikTok said.

BytePlus is the enterprise technology arm of TikTok parent company ByteDance, and it manages all of the company’s AI tools and systems. [...] TikTok has added some new elements to its artificial intelligence-powered Symphony ad creation tools, including advanced video generation using the latest models, an updated Symphony API and broader access to AI usage tokens.

First, TikTok added more capacity to generate video ads using the latest Dreamina Seedance AI models within its Symphony Agent tool.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là một hàm Python tính số Fibonacci sử
 dụng phương pháp đệ quy (recursion):

```python
def fibonacci(n):
    """Tính số Fibonacci thứ n sử dụng đệ quy."""
    # Trường hợp cơ sở (base cases)
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    # Bước đệ quy
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)

# Ví dụ sử dụng:
# print(fibonacci(6))  # Kết quả: 8
```

*Lưu ý:* Phương pháp đệ quy thuần túy này rất dễ hiểu nhưng không hiệu quả với các số $n$ lớn (vì tính lặp lại nhiều lần các giá trị trùng nhau). Nếu bạn cần tính với $n$ lớn, có thể dùng phương pháp ghi nhớ (memoization) hoặc vòng lặp.

https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.summary:
Nov 6 (Reuters) - OpenAI has closed ‌on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round ​that values the company ​at $1.25 trillion, a source familiar with ⁠the matter said on Friday.

The $11 ​billion raised so far represents ​only a portion of OpenAI's original target of up to $30 billion, while ​the company's valuation has ​come down from the $1.5 trillion level it ‌had ⁠initially sought, two investors said.
